about: The Thrustmaster T.Flight Hotas X's defaults (modern-iaf/docs/front-end.md §9.3) as Godot reports it with shared/controls/joystick.gd's mapping (docs/controls.md §5.2): stick x, stick y, throttle, rudder (twist) on axes 0-3, the rocker on axis 4 in 5-axis mode; buttons {key-table record: 0-based button}, the hat on 32..35 (up, right, down, left). The button choice is ours (inferred: the trigger fires the gun, the thumb buttons release and pick targets).
